description: Erection of a single-storey rear infill extension at no. 8, and the erection of a joint first-floor rear extension at nos. 6 and 8 Olinda Road.
decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-351e88a3-7fff-8d8b-6e7a-d285f76c2c70"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">The proposed first-floor rear infill extension, by reason of its full-width form and the infilling of the void between the original rear outriggers, would remove an established visual break that contributes positively to the character and articulation of the terrace.
